Valmont depot: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, certified June 2023 (renewal due June 2028). Operations lead Halvard Onstad; night supervisor Teodora Blaskovic. Average 410 daily departures, winter peak 530; 1.8% cancellations. Night shift understaffed.

February 2025: brake line failure grounded nine vehicles four days; cause unestablished. Brake checks every 6,000 km. September 2024: cloned fuel cards lost €4,200. Fuel cards need second approval above €200; parts above €500 need two quotes. Route changes need seven days' notice; incidents filed within 24 hours.

Electrification study approved but unfunded; second charging bay due Q3. Old ticketing terminals on three routes. May 2026: duplicate roster left two shifts uncovered; rosters need one named publisher. Winter peak capacity unmodelled.
